buyNowDialog.mainBodyTitle1: Automation, context and intelligent action with IBM Instana Observability
buyNowDialog.mainBodyDescription1: Our industry-leading, one-second granularity and comprehensive request tracing guarantee that no issue escapes detection. Gain full-stack visibility across application code, Kubernetes containers, and microservices with user-friendly dashboards and SmartAlerts™ for tailored alerting. Seamlessly integrated into AWS, Instana supports over 300 technologies, providing worry-free performance monitoring for containerized applications on Amazon AWS.
buyNowDialog.mainBodyDescription2: Designed to give you flexibility, our PayPerUse tiers provide function and value with Standard and Essential options to meet your business needs. You'll be billed at the end of each month based on usage.
